candidate_freeze.note: The v6 candidate freeze configs/research_v6_candidate_freeze.json is the artifact that freezes the candidate set; it is produced after this manifest and is referenced by it, not the other way round.

code_hash_note: code_hash is the authorized value of record for the hashed set, cross-checked against research_state/campaign_authorization.json. The ordered digest is checkout-dependent; canonical_source_digest is the portable identity of the tree and the live ordered digest is an environment fact, never an identity.

exclusion_rules_application.application_order: the inherited fixed lists are evaluated first, then the published classifier groups in their published group_order; the first group that matches an entry is the recorded exclusion group

fixed_lists.rule: the v1 exclusion_rules fixed lists, applied verbatim as configs/research_v6.json -> universe.eligibility_validation.exclusion_rules requires

exclusion_rules_application.note: The v6 specification names the v1 exclusion_rules fixed lists and the six exclusion categories; the published classifier of the effective v4 exclusion amendment implements exactly those six categories and is reused read-only.

published_classifier.reuse_rule: the classifier is reused read-only: the amendment is hash-bound, it is never edited by the v6 chain, and only its classifier block is used -- its v4 derived classification and derived candidate batch are not

expansion_scope.ordering_rule: strictly descending market-capitalization order; the batch holds exactly 20 assets unless the snapshot runs out of eligible names

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with the manifest_hash key removed. The snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash is the manifest_hash of research/data_manifest_v6.json.

market_cap_source.note: Current-universe snapshot used; historical point-in-time ranks unavailable. Results have survivorship limitations.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v6.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

supersedes.note: The v5 universe manifest is immutable and is not edited by this version; the v6 universe is the next band below the recomputed v5 floor, and no v6 constituent is an asset of the v1, v2, v3, v4 or v5 universe.

survivorship_disclaimer: This universe uses one current market-cap snapshot (2026-10-22T01:17:30Z) from CoinGecko. Historical point-in-time market-cap data is not available from a verifiably free source. This universe has survivorship and selection bias limitations. Assets that have fallen out of the top 20 or delisted are excluded. Do not describe this as a historically point-in-time-selected market portfolio.
